availability.note: Cupra AU Terramar page lists six grades (S, V, VZ, VZ Tribe Edition Black, VZ Tribe Edition Green, VZe); VZe is the only PHEV and links to Configure now. Prices load by region in script and were not readable.

listPrice.note: GoAuto 11 Aug 2026 MY26 offer table: VZe $77,990 +ORC (no drive-away deal on VZe; offers ended 30 Sep 2026). CarsGuide and CarExpert review: 'from $77,990 before on-road costs'; Chasing Cars '$77,990 RRP', VIC drive-away $83,490. App drive-away for $77,990 is $82,146, below the advertised VIC $83,490 (gap $1,344, consistent with dealer delivery), so $77,990 is a list price. Manufacturer price not directly readable (script-loaded).

batteryKwh.note: usable; ADAC Batteriekapazitaet (Brutto) 25,8 / (Netto) 19,7 kWh for Terramar 1.5 e-HYBRID VZ (200 kW). Cupra technical data '25,8 (~20 net)'; electrifying.com '19.7kWh (25.8kWh total)'.

rangeKm.note: Cupra AU: '109km Electric Vehicle Range' / 'Electric range up to 109 km', footnote 2: derived from ADR 81/02 testing incl. WLTP where applicable. Below the European WLTP band 112-121 km (Cupra technical data) and 118 km for the 20-inch VZ Tribe (ADAC 346748), so WLTP-derived local spec. Launch reviews (CarExpert, Chasing Cars) quoted 110 km WLTP; held value was 110.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh 19.7 / rangeKm 109 x 100 = 18.07. Cross-check: European WLTP EV-mode band 17.5-19.0 kWh/100km (Cupra technical data).

combinedRangeKm.note: rangeKm 109 + 45 L tank / 5.7 L/100km x 100 (789.5) = 898. Tank 45 L from Cupra technical data and CarExpert review. Cupra's own WLTP total range is 830-910 km.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: ADAC 'Verbrauch kombiniert (WLTP) PHEV (Batterie leer)' 5,7 L/100km for Terramar 1.5 e-HYBRID VZ Tribe Edition on 255/40R20 (AU VZe is on 20-inch); 19-inch VZ (ADAC 336903) also 5,7. Cupra technical data charge-sustaining band 5,7-6,1. Same basis as vw-tayron-phev (5.9, heavier car). CarExpert observed 5.3/5.9 with battery mostly flat. Held 7.0 was judged.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: Cupra AU label 'Fuel consumption 1.8L/100 km' (ADR 81/02), at or below 3.5. Launch label was 0.5 L/100km (CarExpert).

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO: green = combined tailpipe CO2 120 g/km or less. Cupra technical data WLTP 9-12 g/km; AU 1.8 L/100km label implies about 42 g/km. Either way well under 120.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Cupra technical data e-HYBRID 'Boot capacity (l) 400 (95th percentile in rear seat)', 490 with rear seat forward; petrol 508. CarExpert and CarsGuide AU reviews: 400 L. VDA to the cover.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: held 2026-08-08 figure; Parkers gives 1,404 L folded for the eHybrid (seen in search result, page paywalled HTTP 402 this run). Not in Cupra technical data or ADAC. Model year and battery unchanged.

seats.note: five-seat SUV; CarExpert review describes the second-row bench

towKg.note: CarExpert AU review 2000 kg braked; Cupra technical data e-HYBRID 2.000 kg at 8% and 12%. CarExpert spec page's 2,200 kg is the 2.0 TSI petrol figure (aggregator error).

warrantyYears.note: '5-year unlimited-kilometre warranty across the entire CUPRA range'; no servicing condition stated

insuranceAnnual.note: held value kept; anchored to vw-tayron-phev 200TSI R-Line ($76,550) 2000, vw-tiguan-phev 200TSI R-Line ($74,550) 1950 and cupra-formentor-phev VZe 1950; Terramar is the dearest of the four

depreciationCurve.note: Cupra brand convention per owner rule (one curve per brand), matching cupra-tavascan V and Endurance rows: steeper than mainstream for thin local volume, sub-brand resale risk and Cupra's history of deep run-out discounting. Held curve was [1,0.67,0.55,0.46,0.39,0.33].

lowConfidence: cupra-terramar-phev-vze.bootLitresSeatsDown: carried 1,404 L; Parkers source paywalled this run, no manufacturer folded figure found
